exposure: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy remote from term (26-34 weeks gestation)
cohort: 447 women aged >16 years admitted to 5 referral hospitals in Ghana with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy between 26 and 34 weeks gestation
finding: Maternal near miss, maternal mortality, and perinatal mortality were common in women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy remote from term in referral hospitals in Ghana.
mod_finding: Nearly all women in the study had a cesarean delivery (84% overall, 93% in the severe maternal outcome group).
